audit.whatIsWrong: The stored level chart gave Heimerdinger four stages in a lane he loses at 46.98% over 149 games, and it contradicted its own whys[] text on five of seven rows.
audit.why: whys[0] has Zac reaching you before your zone exists, whys[2] has him slinging on before your nest is online, whys[5] and whys[6] hand him the item stages; only whys[4] is a clean Heimerdinger row. The packet chart (Zac/Skill/Zac/Skill/Heimerdinger/Zac/Zac) matches the prose and the win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group, ratings matched.

audit.why: spikes[] already has four entries covering Lvl 1-2, Lvl 4-5, Lvl 6 and 2+ items, and they line up with the corrected chart: your only owned stage is 6, his are the tank-item stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: none of Zac's abilities were named in the full layer, and neither the percent-max-health damage nor the Q auto-reset tell appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Kit: Stretching Strikes (Q) 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, grab plus auto reset; Unstable Matter (W) 5s, percent maximum health magic damage; Elastic Slingshot (E) 21/18/15/12/9s, his only gap-close; Let's Bounce! (R) 120/105/90s; Cell Division (P) heals off reabsorbed blobs and revives from bloblets. Mirror audit confirms only a direct CH-3X hit stuns — the splash only slows — which the content layer already states.
audit.corrected: Named Elastic Slingshot and Unstable Matter with cooldowns, added the percent-health warning against pure MR, and made the Q wind-up the step-back cue.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in report[8].t, which is right against Cell Division blob pickups.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. E-stun/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Elastic Slingshot: 21s at rank 1, 9s maxed — his only way in, so the moment it is spent you own the lane. - Unstable Matter: 5s, percent max health, so MR alone will not save you. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.after: 21s at rank 1 — stun him on the landing, then fight while it is down.

edits.before: Track Zac's Elastic Slingshot: His engage. E-stun/dodge it. When it is down — E-stun + turret him.
edits.after: Unstable Matter hits percent max health every 5s, so MR alone loses — stun his landing, then turret him.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Elastic Slingshot: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Elastic Slingshot: down, run the full pattern; up, give nothing. His Q is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back.

notes: Mirror (audits/top/zac__heimerdinger.json) records Heimerdinger's E as "CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade" while this page uses "CH-3X Lightning Grenade" throughout. Heimerdinger's own kit file carries no ability names, so I could not settle it from the data and did not change either side — this needs one decision applied to both pages. Zac's E carries a derived "grounding" flag that Riot's description does not support (it only launches him forward); I treated that as a parsing misfire and asserted nothing about grounding. Also left the mirror's open question alone: whether turret beams can destroy Cell Division blobs is unverifiable from the kits, so no text here claims it.
